title: 第八章 天门山
content_zh:
许元觉得自己挺傻的，真的。
他居然在指望一个能把人质活生生冻死的白痴能在野外的辨别方向。
沉默两秒，许元抬手在冉青墨肩头轻轻拍了拍以示安慰，收起地图站起身，低声道：
“你先带我去周遭的最高点看看，也许我大概能分辨出位置来。”
冉青墨眸子动了动，眼神有些怀疑。
许元知道对方在怀疑什么，轻声道：
“这些年来，我游手好闲，但还是学了一些东西。”
“哦。”
许元走到洞口，看着外面烟雨朦胧的森海景色，回眸看了一眼正在收拾行囊的黑衣女子，低声道：
“外面还在下雨。”
冉青墨看了一眼他，又看了看他腰间别着的水囊袋。
许元微微叹了口气，看着对方那湿漉漉的黑衣：
“我知道有这焱灵液，风寒一类的疾病暂时是不用担心，可你不觉得穿着湿衣服很不舒服么？”
冉青墨眸子眨了眨，仔细感受了一下，认同的点了点头。
许元略微思索，侧眸看了一眼那根在雨幕中依旧贯穿在焱灵蟒尸体上的冰锥。
............
一分钟后，
一男一女凌空站在数十米的高空之上。
男子一袭锦绸华袍，手里拿着一张羊皮卷，女子面掩薄纱，身姿窈窕，手中握着一把冰晶制成的雨伞站在男子身侧。
雨将住，风未停，山里瓢泼般的大雨变成细软绵延。

站在冉青墨用 “炁”凝结成的透明平台，脚下是数十米的巨树形成的蔚然林海，俯瞰而下一眼望不到尽头。
万兴山脉横亘大炎皇朝的西南边境，绵延数万里。
白雾很大程度影响了许元的视线，不过来到这处高地后，许元发现自己压根不需要辨别方向。
遥遥望去，在那林海的尽头，一道庞大的山峰黑影遮天蔽日。
即便相距百里，在烟雨朦胧的雨幕之间也依稀可见其庞然，如同一尊横亘在天地间的吞天巨兽，前世的世界屋脊在其面前也宛若婴孩。
当游戏的一纸地图化为现实，眼前的震撼溢于言表。
许元眯着眼眸，盯着那庞然黑影：
“那里是...天门山？”
冉青墨撑着伞，袍袖随风轻轻飘动：
“嗯。”
“能登上去么？”
“你说的洞府是在那上面？”
“对。”
天门山上那处洞府《沧源》王道热血世界线里的一处隐藏地图。
触发的条件也很老套。
被追杀、逃入万兴山脉，爬上天门山、被逼跳崖，福缘超过80，跳崖后便能进入那处隐藏的洞府。
福缘不到80？那就等着自由落体吧。
思绪闪过，许元轻轻摇了摇头。
在游戏公式书上，他记得自己原身这位三公子的福缘只有3，去那悬天崖跳一百次都不可能进去，属于是投胎把这辈子的运气都用光了。
不过现在许元身边有冉青墨这个大高手，到了悬天崖，带着他飞下去慢慢找就好了。

冉青墨盯着那庞然的天门山沉默两秒，道：
“好。”
话音落下，
她直接撤去了二人脚下由炁所凝结的平台。
“.........”许元。
自由落体的感觉并不好受，不过好在冉青墨这白痴女人还是知道这么高掉下来，他这个普通人会直接摔成肉饼。
临落地前，一道巧劲悄然包裹了许元周身，二人以公主抱的姿势成功落入了树林之中。
冉青墨单手撑伞，对视一眼，轻轻将许元从怀中放到了地上，平静的说道：
“我们走吧。”
许元站稳脚跟，拍了拍衣袍掩饰尴尬，闻言后却皱了皱眉：
“走？”
“嗯。”冉青墨点头。
许元在脑海中大概估算了一下天门山与他们所处位置的距离，重复道：
“你的意思是我们走过去？”
冉青墨歪了歪头： “不然呢？”
“你不是会飞么？”许元面带古怪： “用走的我们至少也得一旬多的时间。”
冉青墨沉默两秒，盯着许元，很认真的说道： “我不会飞。”
“可刚才.....”许元指了指天空。
冉青墨顺着他的手指望了望天空，解释道：
“那是我功法里的 “冰云阶”。”

“冰云阶？”许元对于这方世界的功法一无所知，下意识问。
冉青墨丝毫没有回答他的意思，只是看着他。
许元意识这种关于功法的问题应该算是隐私，转而开口问道：
“御剑飞行你不会？”
冉青墨思索两秒，轻声道：
“我的功法里没有御剑飞行，只有冰云阶，御剑飞行是悬天剑诀里的。”
听到这个悬天剑诀的名字，许元脑海迅速掠过游戏公式书中对这功法的介绍。
但却没有回忆起介绍里有关于御剑飞行这一条，想来应该世界对相关信息的自动补全。
不过经过冉青墨这一番话语，许元也大概明白了对方的意思。
这方世界里有御空而行的手段，但因为功法的不同，飞行的手段也会不同。
顿了顿，许元问道；
“那为何不直接用你这冰云阶带着我过去？”
冉青墨没有立刻回答，上下打量了许元这身子骨一眼，才摇头道：
“你身体太弱，会死。”
“可刚才我不是没事么？”许元皱眉，刚才冉青墨带着她跳上半空辨认方位，他丝毫没有感觉到不适。
“刚才的速度，很慢。”
“......”许元不说话了。
他发现自己有些想当然，想当然到一个很重要的问题都被他忽略。
人体能承受的加速度是有限的。
冉青墨御空的方式明显是用炁凝结可供踩踏的平台，在空中不断的跳跃。

他这位被酒色掏空了身体的公子哥来说，可能无防护可能7~9G的加速度便能直接送他归西。
而以冉青墨先前那肉眼不可见的速度，起码是30g加速度起步。
想至此处，许元略显感激的看了眼前的黑纱女子一眼。
虽然她偶尔看起来有些呆呆的，但在这些方面还是很靠谱的。
若是没有她没有想到这一茬，可能刚一加速，他直接就暴毙了。
转瞬，许元又想到让冉青墨控制速度。
不过这想法一出转瞬就被他打消了。
冉青墨可以控制速度，但那样会使二人的滞空时间变长。
这万兴山脉妖兽丛生，方才随便抓来的一只焱灵蟒都被是都是那神秘势力手下的妖，滞空时间变长难免不会被藏匿在暗处的妖兽发现。
而且妖兽这种生物可并不仅仅只有地上有。
有些空中鸟类妖兽的视觉可比人类要强多了。
徒步行走，有树丛遮掩，加之有冉青墨这个高手的感
知周围，不能百分百不被发现，最起码还能保证不留活口。
许元轻轻叹了口气，环视了一圈这一眼望不到头的茫然森海。
徒步走就徒步吧，全当做来异界的第一次旅行了。
content_en:
Xu Yuan felt that he was quite stupid, really.
He was actually expecting an idiot who could freeze hostages to death to be able to identify directions in the wild.
After two seconds of silence, Xu Yuan raised his hand and patted Ran Qingmo's shoulder to express comfort. He put away the map and stood up, whispering:
"First take me to the highest point in the surrounding area. Maybe I can roughly identify the location."
Ran Qingmo's eyes moved with suspicion.
Xu Yuan knew what the other party was suspecting and said softly:
“I’ve been idle over the years, but I’ve learned a few things.”
"Oh."
Xu Yuan walked to the entrance of the cave, looked at the misty forest sea scene outside, looked back at the woman in black who was packing her luggage, and whispered:
"It's still raining outside."
Ran Qingmo glanced at him and then at the water bag on his waist.
Xu Yuan sighed slightly and looked at the other party's wet black clothes:
"I know that with this Yanling Liquid, you don't have to worry about diseases such as wind and cold for the time being, but don't you feel uncomfortable wearing wet clothes?"
Ran Qingmo blinked, felt it carefully, and nodded in agreement.
Xu Yuan thought for a moment and glanced sideways at the ice pick that was still pierced through the body of the Yanling Python in the rain.
............
One minute later,
A man and a woman stood dozens of meters in the air.
The man wore a brocade silk robe and held a sheepskin scroll in his hand. The woman, her face covered with gauze and graceful, stood beside the man holding an umbrella made of ice crystals.
The rain is about to stop, but the wind has not stopped, and the pouring rain in the mountains has turned into a soft and continuous stream.
Standing on the transparent platform condensed by Ran Qingmo with "Qi", under your feet is a forest sea formed by tens of meters of giant trees. From a bird's eye view, you can see the end.
The Wanxing Mountains stretch across the southwest border of the Dayan Dynasty and stretch for tens of thousands of miles.
The white fog greatly affected Xu Yuan's vision, but after arriving at this highland, Xu Yuan found that he did not need to discern the direction at all.
Looking from a distance, at the end of the forest sea, a huge black shadow of a mountain peak covered the sky and the sun.
Even though it is hundreds of miles away, its majestic size can still be vaguely seen in the misty rain curtain, like a sky-devouring giant beast that stretches between heaven and earth, and the roof of the world in the previous life is like a baby in front of it.
When the map of the game became reality, the shock before my eyes was beyond words.
Xu Yuan squinted his eyes and stared at the huge black figure:
"Where is...Tianmen Mountain?"
Ran Qingmo held an umbrella, her robe sleeves fluttering gently in the wind:
"Yeah."
"Can I go up there?"
"Where is the cave you are talking about?"
"Yes."
The cave on Tianmen Mountain is a hidden map in the world line of "Cangyuan".
The trigger conditions are also very old-fashioned.
He was hunted, fled into the Wanxing Mountains, climbed Tianmen Mountain, and was forced to jump off a cliff. His fortune exceeded 80. After jumping off the cliff, he could enter the hidden cave.
Less than 80 blessings? Then wait for the free fall.
Thoughts flashed through, Xu Yuan shook his head gently.
In the game formula book, he remembered that his original third son's luck was only 3, and he could not get in even if he jumped a hundred times on the cliff. He would have used up all his luck in this life by reincarnation.
But now that Xu Yuan has a master like Ran Qingmo beside him, when he arrives at Xantian Cliff, he can just take him to fly down and look for him slowly.
Ran Qingmo stared at the majestic Tianmen Mountain in silence for two seconds and said:
"Okay."
The words fell,
She directly removed the platform condensed by Qi under their feet.
"..." Xu Yuan.
The feeling of free fall is not pleasant, but fortunately, Ran Qingmo, an idiot woman, still knows that if he falls from such a height, an ordinary person like him will be smashed into a meat pie.
Before landing, a magical force quietly wrapped around Xu Yuan's body, and the two of them successfully fell into the woods in the posture of a princess.
Ran Qingmo held an umbrella with one hand, looked at each other, gently put Xu Yuan from his arms to the ground, and calmlysaid:
"Let's go."
Xu Yuan stood firm and patted his robe to cover up his embarrassment. After hearing this, he frowned:
"Go?"
"Yeah." Ran Qingmo nodded.
Xu Yuan roughly estimated the distance between Tianmen Mountain and their location in his mind, and repeated:
"You mean we walk over there?"
Ran Qingmo tilted his head: "What else?"
"Don't you know how to fly?" Xu Yuan said with a strange expression, "It will take at least ten days for us to leave."
Ran Qingmo was silent for two seconds, stared at Xu Yuan, and said seriously: "I can't fly."
"But just now..." Xu Yuan pointed to the sky.
Ran Qingmo followed his hand and looked at the sky, explaining:
"That's the "Ice Cloud Step" in my technique."
"Bingyun level?" Xu Yuan asked subconsciously as he knew nothing about the techniques in this world.
Ran Qingmo didn't mean to answer him at all, just looked at him.
Xu Yuan realized that questions about exercises should be considered private, so he turned to ask:
"You don't know how to fly with a sword?"
Ran Qingmo thought for two seconds and said softly:
"My technique does not include sword flying, only the Ice Cloud Stage. Sword flying is part of the Xuantian Sword Technique."
Hearing the name of the Xuantian Sword Technique, Xu Yuan's mind quickly flashed through the introduction to this technique in the game formula book.
But I didn’t recall that there was an item about flying with a sword in the introduction. I guess the world automatically completed related information.
However, after Ran Qingmo's words, Xu Yuan roughly understood what the other party meant.
There are ways to fly in the air in this world, but because of different skills, the means of flying will also be different.
After a pause, Xu Yuan asked;
"Then why don't you just use your Ice Cloud Step to take me there?"
Ran Qingmo did not answer immediately. He looked Xu Yuan's body up and down before shaking his head and saying:
"You are too weak and will die."
"But wasn't I fine just now?" Xu Yuan frowned. Just now Ran Qingmo jumped up into the air with her to identify the direction, and he didn't feel any discomfort at all.
"The speed just now was very slow."
"..." Xu Yuan stopped talking.
He found that he had taken things for granted, so much so that a very important issue had been ignored by him.
There is a limit to the acceleration the human body can withstand.
Ran Qingmo's way of controlling the air is obviously to use Qi to condense a platform for stepping on, and jump continuously in the air.
For him, a young man whose body had been drained by alcohol and sex, maybe without protection or even with an acceleration of 7~9G, he could be sent home directly.
And with Ran Qingmo's previous speed that was invisible to the naked eye, it would start at at least 30g acceleration.
Thinking of this, Xu Yuan glanced at the woman in black gauze with gratitude.
Although she occasionally looks a little dull, she is still very reliable in these aspects.
If she hadn't thought of this, he might have died suddenly as soon as he accelerated.
In a flash, Xu Yuan thought of letting Ran Qingmo control the speed.
However, this idea was dismissed by him as soon as it occurred.
Ran Qingmo can control the speed, but that will make the two of them stay in the air longer.
The Wanxing Mountains are teeming with monsters. The Yan Spirit Python that was caught just now was a monster under that mysterious force. As it stays in the air for a longer time, it will inevitably not be discovered by the monsters hiding in the dark.
And creatures like monsters are not only found on the ground.
The vision of some aerial bird monsters is much stronger than that of humans.
Walking on foot, you are covered by trees, and you have the feeling of being a master like Ran Qingmo.
If you know your surroundings, you can't be 100% undetected. At the very least, you can ensure that no one is left alive.
Xu Yuan sighed softly and looked around at the endless sea of ​​confusion.
If you want to go on foot, just go on foot. Treat it as your first trip to another world.
